summary: Great Elm Capital Corp. filed an 8-K announcing it is exercising its option to redeem in whole its 5.875% Notes due 2026 (CUSIP 390320604; NASDAQ: GECCO) at 100% of principal plus accrued interest through the Redemption Date of May 27, 2026. The redemption is made pursuant to Section 1104 of the Base Indenture and Section 1.01(h) of the Fourth Supplemental Indenture with Equiniti Trust Company, LLC as trustee. This is a routine full call of outstanding debt, not an extraordinary special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned; the action is a standard liability management move by the issuer under its indenture.
